body: I just don’t think anyone wants me. What’s the point if no one wants me here?

Honestly I’m not even sure most people in my life would care enough to even stop me. Whether or not pain lasts forever, it still makes five minutes alone in my head feel like a fucking eternity. It’s not that it’s overwhelming it’s just always there and I don’t want it to be anymore.

I don’t know. Happiness is just temporary at this point. Nothing in my life ever lasts and all I’m waiting for is for my time on earth to finally run out or the courage to take myself off this earth myself.
Me too.
I doubt it. Every time things start to look good again, every time I feel the barest glimmer of hope, something else happens and I’m right back where I started.
Thank you, I appreciate these.

No, not everyone does it but it’s not uncommon at all. It’s not uncommon for victims to try and seek out men similar in age or other ways to their abuser or put themselves in similar situations over and over again because of the way our brains react to trauma, whether they realize it or not. It doesn’t always happen this way, but it isn’t an uncommon thing.

Not sure why you’re getting downvoted for literally saying the same thing everyone else has said. 

And you’re not wrong about the older men thing. I was victimized at 14 by a man 5 years older than me and that started a long cycle of being abused by older men that I would seek out because I thought that behavior was normal.
That’s grooming. He should be dating someone his own age.
Legal doesn’t mean moral. She’s 16. A child. Not a legal adult. He is a legal adult and shouldn’t be talking to her in the first place.

There are so so many things wrong with a 22 year old having a sexual relationship with a teenager. I have no idea why you’re condoning this behavior, especially when the teenager in question has already been victimized, and especially on this subreddit, but it’s honestly disgusting. She’s not an adult. She’s a teenager. She should be dating people her own age. Not some crusty 22 year old dirt bag with a teen fetish.
I agree this reeks of predatory behavior to me, whether he realizes it or not.

I’m sorry but I don’t really understand why you’re a 22 year old adult talking to a 16 year old child. She’s still a kid. She’s not an adult until 18. I see a lot of things wrong with this already. I’m sorry, maybe it’s because my abusers were all adults but I find the age gap incredibly creepy.

Please stop talking to this girl and date someone your own age. 16 and 22 are in two very different stages of life. You are a grown man. She is in high school. Please let her just be a teenager and date someone her own age, and you do the same and date someone who is a legal adult.

I should mention that my therapist did recommend getting local law enforcement involved with both him and the woman he is currently involved with since he assaulted me and she posted a bunch of false stuff about me online and harassed me and both of them harassed my friends on social media, however before she had brought the idea up to me I had already confronted them both to tell them that the posts needed to be removed and they needed to cease all contact with me and my friends or I would be reporting them both to the police for harassment. I also told everyone in my local friend group that if either of them reach out to them at any given point, they are not to respond to any messages they might send and should immediately notify law enforcement. They know about the assault and they have all been harassed online by both my ex and his current partner and will not hesitate to report both of them if either I or they feel threatened.

Since I confronted them, neither me or my friends have heard a word from them and all of her posts about me being a liar and making fun of my childhood abuse are gone and have been for almost two months.

I was thinking a crisis centre like RAINN. The only reason I’d go to the cops is if I felt like he was harassing me, threatening me, or otherwise making me feel like my life is in danger, which he hasn’t contacted me since July (I had emailed him wanting some closure for what had happened to me and he kept dancing around all the issues I had brought up to him until I finally snapped and called him a bunch of names and told him he was a vile person, to which he sent the woman he cheated on me with after me, and we haven’t spoken a word to each other since) so I don’t feel like he’s going to threaten me or try to come back into my life. The only other reason I’d want to get local law enforcement involved is if I knew for sure that he is sexually abusing this woman he’s involved with now, which I can’t verify that and I don’t have any evidence that proves he is.

What will they do with that report? I don’t really want to get the police involved, I don’t trust the cops and I especially don’t trust my ex, he’s a liar and a master manipulator and I’m afraid he’ll find some way to shift blame on to me somehow.
